Name: Locked Valley
Author: Josatamana
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Description[/size][/b][/center]
[center]Locked Valley adds a small, lasting tension to your days in Pelican Town.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Every morning, a part of your maximum energy is locked away. You can still see it on your energy bar, but no food or drink will fill it. To get it back, you can soak in the spa for the day... or hand your Chastity Key to someone you trust and let her decide when you deserve release.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]A contract unlocks your energy for good, but it comes with a price. Every few days the Stage rises, the debuffs grow heavier, and your key holder expects you to come back to her. Wait long enough and she'll start giving you requests. Endure, and the reward is worth it.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]This mod has adult themes. Everything is told through items, systems and dialogue that is suggestive, not explicit.[/center]
[center]
[b][size=5]Feedback & Suggestions[/size][/b]
Want more content? Leave a comment! I'm happy to hear ideas for new items, features, or characters beyond the current six. The most requested characters will be added in future updates.
[/center]
[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]3. (Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu to change settings in-game.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]4. Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]To uninstall, just delete the LockedValley folder. Your save stays clean: the extra energy is removed before every save.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]Energy lock[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Your max energy grows by about 11%, but that part is locked every morning.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Scales with Stardrops.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Soak in the spa for 10 in-game minutes to unlock it for the day.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Contracts[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Buy a Chastity Key from the Dwarf and give it to Abigail, Haley, Leah, Emily, Penny or Maru.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- She accepts or refuses based on your friendship, dating or marriage.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- A Chastity Cage or Belt is locked into a new equipment slot on your inventory page.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Use the Freedom Key to cancel the contract (only at Stage 1).[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Stages[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- The Stage rises over time, shown next to your farm name in the inventory.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Higher Stages bring Tipsy, Burnt, Nauseated and Monster Musk.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Talk to your key holder to reset the Stage, or complete her daily request at higher Stages.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Rewards: 8 creams and nectars, stronger the longer you endured.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Relationships matter[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Breaking up, divorce and the Witch's Hut all change what happens to your contract.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Lose the key? The Wizard might be able to fix it, for a price.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Harvey offers a permanent way out... if you can find what he lost.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Configurable (GMCM)[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Days per Stage, locked energy %, spa soak time, when requests start.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Turn each character on or off.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]- Turn Stage debuffs and the morning item on or off.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[center]- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/center]
[center]- SMAPI 4.0 or later[/center]
[center]- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game settings)[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Notes[/center]
[center]- Language: English only for now. Translations are welcome: copy i18n/default.json, translate it and send it to me.[/center]
[center]- Tested in single player. Multiplayer is not tested yet.[/center]
[center]- Found a bug? Type lv_status in the SMAPI console and include the result in your report.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/center]
